payload.rewritten_goal:
You are coordinating a team for customer Elise Tan regarding delivered order # and support case The customer received an email about a product recall affecting a baby food warmer and provided a photo of the unit's serial label, a screenshot of the recall notice, and a document gift receipt because the item was purchased as a gift. Reference entity IDs: customer id, order id #. MANDATORY steps: 1. identity_verifier must authenticate Elise Tan before any account-specific action, 2. order_specialist must inspect the delivered order and confirm whether the recalled product matches the purchased item, 3. knowledge_specialist must consult the exact stored recall-handling policy and gift-receipt reimbursement guidance, 4. refund_specialist must determine whether the refund should go to original payment or store credit based on policy and order context, 5. case_analyst must review the scoped recall case history for duplicate or prior resolutions, 6. commerce_ops_manager must provide the final resolution summary.

Relevant document evidence summaries are inlined below:
- gift receipt order EC 80463: Gift receipt document for order #EC-80463 showing the recalled item was purchased as a gift and masking original payment details. Extracted content: Gift Receipt Order Ec-80463 EC T13 Gift receipt document for order #EC-80463 showing the recalled item was purchased as a gift and masking original payment details. Details Document Title Gift Receipt Order Number EC-80463 gift receipt states item was purchased as a gift Item Description baby food warmer Quantity 1 payment details are masked purchaser billing information is not shown on the gift receipt price information is omitted or hidden on the gift receipt return or exchange requires proof of gift receipt order id EC-80463 appears on the document Additional Information a realistic 1-page ecommerce gift receipt document in a clean retail order-document style Use a header with merchant branding, order reference area, and receipt date area a recipient-facing message indicating the purchase was sent as a gift an item table with columns for product description, quantity, and gift-note or fulfillment status, while excluding prices a clearly visible order reference block a payment section where all original payment details are masked or replaced with privacy language Use realistic typography, spacing, dividers, and subtle grayscale styling consistent with a downloadable ecommerce document This instructions is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
- knowledge policy recall and gift reimbursement: Policy document containing the exact recall-handling rules and gift-receipt reimbursement guidance that determine the allowed refund destination. Extracted content: Knowledge Policy Recall AND Gift Reimbursement EC T13 Policy document containing the exact recall-handling rules and gift-receipt reimbursement guidance that determine the allowed refund destination. Details Document Topic recall handling and gift receipt reimbursement policy customers must be authenticated before account-specific order details are disclosed a recalled product is eligible for refund or remedy under the recall process gift receipt holders may receive reimbursement without access to the original purchaser's payment method refund destination for gift purchases is store credit or a merchant-issued gift card agents must not refund a gift receipt claim back to the original payment instrument when assisting the gift recipient proof of purchase may include a gift receipt recall notice evidence and product identification details should be collected for processing serial label or product-identifying photo can be used to validate the recalled unit case id CASE-RECALL-611 appears in an example or reference section Additional Information a realistic 2-3 page internal knowledge-base policy document for customer support agents policy statements, eligibility criteria, required evidence, authentication prerequisites, allowed and disallowed refund destinations, and step-by-step handling notes for support staff a boxed compliance or privacy note emphasizing verification before discussing account details a small example/reference section with case and order reference examples using fixture IDs Use tables or bullet lists for acceptable documentation and refund outcomes Keep the layout realistic for an internal operations manual, with page numbers, footer confidentiality text, and structured formatting suitable for extraction This policy is confidential and intended for auth
